meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 在关键操作节点记录每一次分发、扫描、解析等事件,产出按 trace_id 串联的证据链和向量索引,并提供按 trace_id、时间窗、官署检索的接口;产物写入 provenance 目录。
howto.when: 构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时使用;由各官署在分发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点调用,或经事件总线异步推送。

say.text: 运行 provenance 阶段,把这次多 Agent 会话的证据链写出来
按 trace_id 检索这次任务的历史证据
向量库写失败了,先把事件缓存到本地 SQLite,之后再补写
say.note: 走失败处理分支,不阻塞主流程

howto.what_en: Records each dispatch, scan and parse event at key nodes, producing a trace_id-linked evidence chain and vector index plus a query API by trace_id, time window or agency; outputs go to the provenance directory.
howto.when_en: When building multi-agent systems that need end-to-end observability and security audit; agencies call it at key nodes such as dispatch, scan and parse, or push events via the bus.

say_en.text: Run the provenance stage to write the evidence chain for this session
say_en.note: Runs run_provenance.py; outputs to the provenance dir

say_en.text: Query history for this task by trace_id
Vector write failed, cache events in local SQLite and backfill later
say_en.note: Uses the failure path, not blocking the main flow
